title: add vpc control plane terraform: multi-az subnets, endpoints, sgs, peering, route53
author: Priya Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Private control plane deployments need a repeatable, auditable Terraform module that provisions the VPC networking primitives we require for Redwood Private control planes. This PR introduces a reusable module and example usage to create multi-AZ private control plane networks including subnets, interface endpoints (S3, ECR, Secrets Manager), managed security groups with narrow egress/ingress, VPC peering resources and automatic route propagation, and Route53 private hosted zone delegations.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds a new Terraform module under infra/terraform/modules/vpc-control-plane that provisions: multi-AZ private and utility subnets, NAT gateways, interface endpoints required for private control plane operation, managed security groups with least-privilege egress, VPC peering resources and automatic route propagation, and Route53 private zone setup for cross-account DNS (delegation records + zone associations).
- Adds an opinionated example in infra/terraform/examples/private-control-plane/ that wires the module for a 3-AZ deployment and documents required IAM roles and cross-account peering acceptance steps.
- Adds terraform fmt/lint automation and a small upgrade guide for customers migrating from the older one-off scripts.

Checklist: 
- [x] Terraform module baseline (resources + variables + outputs)
- [x] Example usage and README with migration notes
- [x] CI: terraform fmt and tflint checks
- [x] Unit tests for small plan diff validation (local-run)
- [x] Security review of default SG rules

Migration notes: This module is opt-in; existing customers using the legacy control-plane scripts will need to follow the upgrade guide in the example README. The module attempts to preserve existing CIDR choices but will not modify existing routed peering connections without explicit configuration.

Related: Linear ENG-3245 (VPC control plane automation), ENG-3421 (peering acceptance automation).

release_notes: Adds terraform module for VPC control plane provisioning (multi-AZ subnets, endpoints, security groups, VPC peering, and Route53 private zone delegation). Optional example and upgrade guide included.
notes_for_ops: Customers using legacy control-plane scripts should follow the example README. Peering acceptance must be completed in the accepter account; the module emits peering and route resources but will not assume cross-account roles by default.
testing: Local terraform plan and tflint run in CI; integration plan run against a sandbox AWS account. Example terraform run (apply) tested in ci-sandbox for provisioning and deletion safety.
security_review: Security reviewed by Lina Zhou: default SGs tightened, allow_all_egress disabled by default, recommended KMS CMK usage documented.
notes: This PR is intentionally conservative: defaults favor least-privilege networking and opt-in automation for cross-account actions. Follow-up PRs planned to add optional peering acceptance automation and automated Route53 delegation record propagation.
